entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
----- 
For the Petitioner : Mr. Vikas Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mrs. Anuradha Sahay, A.P.P. .....
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest in connection with Sahibganj (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 10 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. No. 69 of 2024 instituted under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, the petitioner has moved to this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.

3. As per FIR, there is allegation of demand of additional dowry from the informant and due to non-fulfillment of which she was subjected to assault and torture in various ways and was ousted from her matrimonial home.
It is further alleged that her husband used to live with another women in Punjab.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is submitted that petitioner has co-operated in the investigation in reply of notice under Section 41 (A) Cr.p.c.
Now charge sheet has been submitted for the offence under Section 498(A) IPC.

It is lastly submitted that the petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case and also abide by all terms and conditions which may be imposed in the matter of granting anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

5. Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State submitted that case is governed by the guidelines as laid down by the Hon'ble Apex court, hence, this anticipatory bail application may be disposed of.
6.

In the above circumstances, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, this anticipatory bail application is disposed off, since petitioner has stated that he has co-operated in Md. 7. Hence, in view of the guidelines issued by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr reported in 2021(10) SCC 773 and without expressing view on the merits of this case, Petitioner is directed to seek regular bail before the concerned trial court which shall be disposed of on the same day.
